name: hud_nanite_panel_init_layout
description: HudUiNanitePanel::InitLayout applies the NANITE layout subtree to the triplet panel, anchors against the hardware layout widget, positions from item 2, and installs the shared clip rectangle.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; this helper is deferred to a coherent HUD nanite/layout source-cluster tier S pass.
The native smoke avoids real asset loading by using null image paths; image layout application is covered by the accepted HudUiLayoutNode::ApplyImageWidget functional target.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x40f2e0 validates signed halving of g_HudUiMgr.hudOriginX for baseX, reading g_HudLayoutHW.widget2 center X/Y into an anchor pair, reading layoutRoot payload[1] as the clip rectangle, applying image widgets from payload[2], payload[3], and payload[4] while reusing the first image pointer, positioning the nanite panel from item[2] center X/Y, adding baseX to the clip left/right, and calling SetBltSourceAndClipRect with a null blit source.

The native smoke verifies baseX adjustment from an odd HUD origin, layout clip loading and horizontal offset, final SetPos from item[2], final SetBltSourceAndClipRect arguments, and center lookups for both the global layout widget and item[2].
